Manifest.Name: GitHub Copilot
Manifest.Description: Use your GitHub Copilot subscription as an LLM provider, with a separate profile per signed-in account
Settings.CacheDescription: How long a confirmed account and model list is reused before a request checks them again. Every request still confirms the account on its own session.
Settings.ProfilesDescription: Each profile appears as its own GitHub Copilot provider, bound to one signed-in account. Requests never fall back to another account.
Status.RuntimeMissing: Download the Copilot runtime below to get started (about 51 MB, verified before use). Then sign in with the official Copilot CLI: run `npx -y @github/copilot` in a terminal, type /login, and choose Refresh accounts.
Status.NoAccounts: No signed-in Copilot account was found. Run `npx -y @github/copilot` in a terminal, type /login, then choose Refresh accounts. A gh CLI login alone is not enough.
Status.SignedOut: {0} is no longer signed in. Sign in again with the Copilot CLI, then choose Refresh accounts.
Action.DownloadDescription: Downloads GitHub's official Copilot runtime (about 51 MB, 143 MB installed) and checks it against a pinned SHA-256.
Action.RefreshDescription: Finds the accounts signed in to the Copilot CLI and reloads each bound account's models.
Action.RemoveDescription: Deletes the downloaded runtime. Your GitHub sign-in and profiles are kept.
Action.RemoveConfirm: Remove the downloaded Copilot runtime? GitHub Copilot stops working until you download it again.
Error.NoAccount: This GitHub Copilot provider has no account. Choose one in the GitHub Copilot plugin settings.
Error.RuntimeMissing: The Copilot runtime is not downloaded. Download it in the GitHub Copilot plugin settings.
Error.Timeout: GitHub Copilot did not answer in time.
Error.SignInRequired: {0} is not signed in to the Copilot CLI. Sign in again, then choose Refresh accounts.
Error.ModelUnavailable: The model {0} is not available to this account. Choose another model.
Error.RequestFailed: GitHub Copilot could not process the text. Check your connection, model access and plan limits, then retry.
Error.InvalidCache: Choose a duration from the list.
Error.TooManyProfiles: You can add at most {0} profiles.
Error.ProfileName: Each profile needs a name of at most {0} characters.
Error.ProfileAccount: Choose a signed-in GitHub account for the profile "{0}".
Error.UnsupportedPlatform: The Copilot runtime is only available for glibc-based Linux on x64 and arm64.
Error.DownloadFailed: The Copilot runtime could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
Error.RuntimeCorrupt: The downloaded Copilot runtime failed verification and was not installed. Try again.
Error.RefreshFailed: The signed-in accounts could not be read. Try again.
Error.SettingsTimeout: The Copilot runtime did not respond in time. Try again.
